entries.note: Pointer focus selects a view without changing its root/session binding. Toolbar focus clears custom editor/terminal/game keyboard routing. Moving a tab keeps its identity. Detaching closes terminal/game display resources but never calls Stop; retained process management belongs to the explicit Sessions controls. Wheel events route to the visible terminal under the latest pointer position and are consumed there, without changing keyboard focus. A focused terminal must not scroll when the pointer is over another view; then leave the event for that view/UI.
